title: Counting a predicate on an initial interval
statement: Let $q$ be a decidable predicate on the natural numbers and let $n$ be a natural number. The number of indices $j<n$ satisfying $q(j)$ equals the count of numbers below $n$ satisfying $q$.
hypotheses_covered: A decidable predicate $q$ on the natural numbers
